description.value: Gojo Little Africa Cafe specializes in Ethiopian and international cuisine on Vancouver's Commercial Drive. It's a sit-down restaurant with no outdoor seating, so cyclists must secure bikes inside before dining. The restaurant serves traditional Ethiopian fare in a casual neighborhood setting.
